answer: Stop reward farming by paying for funded work units, never identities. Buyers escrow payment for uniquely numbered simulations of summit erosion, basalt fractures and glacier flow. A contract releases each payment once, after checking a proof of the requested computation, and gives no signup grant. Sending the same result through a thousand accounts cannot earn a second payout. More income requires solving more funded jobs, with real compute costs; self-funded sham jobs merely return the attacker their own escrow, minus fees.
